findings.claim: The PGlite mock omits the `whenDbReady` export required by `write-queue.ts`, so the Vitest suite can fail during module import.
findings.evidence: `src/lib/db/write-queue.ts` imports `getDbInstance, whenDbReady` from `@/lib/db/pglite`, but this test's `vi.mock("@/lib/db/pglite", () => ({ getDbInstance: () => ({ insertMessage }), }))` provides only `getDbInstance`; this violates the blocking `tests-pass` constraint (`npm test`).
findings.suggested_fix: Add `whenDbReady: () => Promise.resolve({ insertMessage })` or otherwise include all named exports consumed by `write-queue.ts` in this mock.

findings.claim: The PGlite mock omits the `whenDbReady` export required by `write-queue.ts`, so the new thread-registry tests can fail during module import.
findings.evidence: `src/stores/thread-registry-store.test.ts` imports `flush` from `@/lib/db/write-queue`, whose module imports `whenDbReady`; the local mock only returns `{ getDbInstance: () => ({ upsertThread, touchThread, deleteThread }) }`, violating the blocking `tests-pass` constraint (`npm test`).
findings.suggested_fix: Add `whenDbReady: () => Promise.resolve({ upsertThread, touchThread, deleteThread })` to the mock.

findings.claim: The PGlite mock omits the `whenDbReady` export required by the stores' write-queue dependency, so this new test can fail before assertions run.
findings.evidence: `use-chat-runtime.onreload.test.tsx` mocks `@/lib/db/pglite` with only `getDbInstance`, while `useChatRuntime` imports stores that use `@/lib/db/write-queue`, and `write-queue.ts` imports `whenDbReady`; this violates the blocking `tests-pass` constraint (`npm test`).
findings.suggested_fix: Include `whenDbReady: () => Promise.resolve({ deleteMessages, insertMessage, upsertThread, touchThread, getMessages })` in the mock.
